review.imagery: 40 gallery entries include 13 dated site photographs. All 24 primary assets, the entire 38-page brochure index, ten native resources and thirteen September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two exact primary repeats, four native textures and a repeated living-room crop were excluded. Five brochure scenes add bedroom, clubhouse and gym details. Several official interiors also appear in other Cove marketing and retain shared-design concept scope. The complete daylight building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All three whole original physical pages 2–4 were visually reviewed. One openly displayed studio preview was separately inspected at native size and supplies no numerical area. Three remaining broker layouts are form-gated and unretrieved. Grouped levels, original technical notes, margins and source-page links remain intact. Three complete building drawings and one attributed broker studio preview are available. No numerical saleable area is printed. The building packet groups floors 1–11. Confirm contractual home areas and current plan revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: The whole original brochure map 32 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Its time rings remain schematic. No invented individual route estimate or coordinate pin was added. The official named-place embed lacks explicit target coordinates.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Branded brochures and drawings retain honest Mitchell’s or Reelly mirror attribution. Public home previews retain their observed open-figure URLs. Full source bytes, notices and completed text research are preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, contractual unit matching for the studio preview, remaining form-gated broker layouts, exact visitor entrance, separately sourced journey estimates, current certified site progress and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
